description: This file defines the AppDatabase class using Room ORM, providing access to the RecipeDao, with seed data initialization upon first creation of the database.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class representing the Room database for recipes, providing a singleton instance and auto-seeding data.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the database, creating it if necessary, with a callback to seed data on creation.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Private method to populate the database with initial sample recipes upon first creation.
